contract.review_scope: Full retained body read, authored input/output/effect/branch/configuration/error/transaction/concurrency explanations; source current per owner.
contract.purpose: Transfer eligible stock to another company, merging destination inventory and reconciling related records.
inputs_defaults: Captured declaration; placeholders are not executable argument values: CREATE PROCEDURE INV_TransferCompany( @item nvarchar(50), @fromCompany nvarchar(25), @toCompany nvarchar(25), @invSts nvarchar(50), @fromWarehouse nvarchar(25), @userDef1 nvarchar(50), @userDef2 nvarchar(50), @userDef3 nvarchar(50), @userDef4 nvarchar(50), @userDef5 nvarchar(50), @userDef6 nvarchar(50), @userDef7 numeric(19,5), @userDef8 numeric(19,5), @transactionType nvarchar(50), @userName nvarchar(30), @refId nvarchar(25), @refType nvarchar(50), @argumentGrpid nvarchar(32), @expDate datetime, @intLocInvNum numeric(9), @fromLocation nvarchar(25), @toLocInvAttributeId numeric(9) = NULL, @toIntLocInv numeric(9)) AS
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: Destination search normalizes NULL identity dimensions but omits warehouse. Item/default-company and old-lot queries can match more than one row. Passing the same source/destination identity is not explicitly prevented. Default destination attribute ID is not itself written to inventory here.
output_shape: No direct row query or OUTPUT parameter. Child outputs can propagate. Validation rejection can return ordinary success after audit; no transfer result object is returned.

ordered_branches.explanation: Validate required item/status/location/warehouse/destination company; permit NULL source company when a companyless ITEM exists. Invalid input logs audit then returns normally if logging succeeds.

Read source by inventory identity with zero allocated/in-transit/suspense and positive on-hand, joining its location. This lookup does not verify supplied item/company/location/warehouse against the row. No eligible row logs audit and returns.

Load destination-company item values. Positive destination attribute ID uses caller destination inventory ID without validating that row; only when source attributes are NULL or zero does the alternate branch search matching destination company/location/lot/logistics/parent with NULL/zero attributes. Positive source attributes with no positive destination attribute skip that lookup. The search omits warehouse and assigns without ordering.

If destination exists, add source quantities, move serial links, under both the feature and item catch-weight gates add destination catch weight and delete source catch weight; source inventory is deleted outside those gates. Then retain destination identity. No destination catch-weight row is inserted when absent.

Update the retained inventory company/status/item metadata/user fields/expiration and recompute totals. For a lot, clone lot/attributes when old-company stock remains and no new-company stock exists; delete old lot/attributes when only new-company stock remains; change lot company when neither remains; leave both-present case unchanged.
Update retained inventory UOM company; insert serial-number arguments; optionally read destination catch weight; call inventory-history wrapper; then delete the entire argument group.

contract.status_and_quantity_effects: Mutates inventory ownership/quantities, serial links, lots/attributes/UOM/catch weight and argument records; saves audit/history through children.
configuration_scope_and_precedence: Two feature helper calls gate catch-weight behavior; current feature values are unobserved. Catch-weight-required ITEM existence is not company-scoped.
error_and_return_handling: Most writes and child returns are checked, but several SELECT checks reuse stale iError. A late failure leaves earlier effects unless caller transaction rolls them back. Argument cleanup is skipped after earlier returns.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit BEGIN TRANSACTION, COMMIT, ROLLBACK, savepoint or SET XACT_ABORT in this body. Caller/session transaction behavior governs partial completion; this contract does not assume atomic child calls.
concurrency: No local transaction or optimistic recheck of source quantities. Destination existence/lot decisions can race; merging and deleting source are separate statements.
contract.trigger_behavior: No captured DML trigger is attached to the direct persistent target tables. Transitive child effects are not inferred.
external_handoffs_and_gaps: Application callers, current record state and active permissions were not observed. No extension, assembly or Azure-function changes are required by this documentation task.
Explicit child/function calls are listed; their exact source contracts bound transitive effects. Opaque selectors are retained as technical evidence, without fabricated labels.
